narrative.overview:
This is a design system built like a handcrafted object, not a software product. Every surface should feel like it was shaped by someone who cared, not generated by a system that scaled. The palette draws from raw materials: fired terracotta, sage-green herbs, warm sand, and aged cream.

The system is fundamentally warm-register. It rejects the cold precision of SaaS and the aggressive maximalism of a gym brand. A visitor should feel like they have walked into a Bangalore studio that smells like eucalyptus and fresh coffee, not landed on a conversion-optimized landing page. Screens breathe. Space is generous. Color is used deliberately, not sprinkled.

The brand surface (public marketing pages) is the voice. The product surface (portals and admin) is the hands. Both share the same palette and type system; the portal surfaces are simply quieter.
keyCharacteristics: Warm, earthy palette anchored by sage and terracotta — neither is decorative, both are structural
Serif-led display hierarchy (Playfair Display) + sans utility (Montserrat) — hard boundary between registers
Generous negative space; sections breathe rather than stack tightly
Photography is the primary decorative layer — real food, real instructors, real space
Lifted surface feedback on interaction; flat at rest

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Sage and terracotta never share equal visual weight on the same surface. One leads; the other accents at 30% or less of the dominant.

rules.name: The No-Pure-White Rule
rules.body: All surfaces use #fafaf8 or warmer. Pure white (#ffffff) is prohibited on large surfaces.

rules.name: The Strict Handoff Rule
rules.body: Playfair Display is forbidden in portal UI text. Montserrat handles all UI surfaces; Playfair handles all brand surfaces.

rules.name: The Italic Sparingly Rule
rules.body: Italic Playfair is a single-use emphasis tool per section. Two italic headings per screen is affectation.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: A card at rest is flat. Shadow appears only as a response to hover or elevation state. shadow-2xl on resting cards is forbidden.

dos: Use Playfair Display for all section headings, product names, and brand moments
Use cream (#f5f2ea) as the primary page background, not white
Let photography carry the decorative load — real images of food, instructors, and the studio space
Vary section heading alignment, size, and structure as you move down the landing page
Use sage for primary CTAs consistently
Add prefers-reduced-motion guards on all keyframe animations
Keep portal milestone/gamification colors within the brand palette (sage and terracotta tones)
Apply sage as the focus ring color on all interactive elements
donts: Don't use identical card grids: icon above heading above text, three across, same size
Don't use backdrop-blur for decorative floating badges — glassmorphism used decoratively is prohibited
Don't add large soft-blur decorative circles (rounded-full blur-3xl) to section backgrounds as texture
Don't assign all testimonials 5 stars — uniform 5-star ratings signal fabrication
Don't use pure #ffffff or #000000 on any surface
Don't use Playfair Display for portal UI labels, table cells, navigation links, or form copy
Don't load unused font families in the Google Fonts import
Don't use Tailwind amber or yellow utilities for portal gamification milestones
Don't use shadow-2xl on resting card states
